topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It was a pleasant surprise when I logged into my social media account one evening and saw a message from an old online friend. We had known each other for years, sharing interests and conversations from the comfort of our screens. They mentioned something casual about the weather, and it triggered a realization. I asked where they were when they noticed the rain, and it turned out they were just a few neighborhoods over. It was one of those coincidences that make you pause and smile, reflecting on how small the world can be. We decided to meet for coffee the next day, bridging the gap between the virtual and the real, finding comfort in the familiar and excitement in the new.
